REGISTER: natural spoken · friendly
THIS SCENE: A and B meet and start talking about today
ONE CONVERSATION — the learner hears ONE continuous conversation; this request writes its next PART (part 1, internal only — never announce it).
CONVERSATION CONTRACT: speakers A = Speaker A (friend) · B = Speaker B (friend) · relationship: friends · opening location: where they meet · objective: spend time together: meet → decide where to go → agree the time → go there → pay · ending goal: they finish what they set out to do and say goodbye
STORY SO FAR: (nothing yet — this part opens the conversation)
NEXT PART GOAL: see THIS SCENE above.
- Do NOT say goodbye: the conversation continues afterwards. End this part on an answer or a statement, not on an open question.
LATER PARTS will use: 那里, 这里, 开, 哪里, 来, 在, 明天, 今天, 等, 现在, 回, 到, 找, 为什么, 小, 用, 很, 太, 钱, 买, 怎么, 大, 拿 (leave them for later).
SCENE INTENT: WHO the same two friends throughout · WHERE where they meet · SITUATION A and B meet and start talking about today · WHY they talk: spend time together: meet → decide where to go → agree the time → go there → pay · WHAT they want to achieve: A and B meet and start talking about today. Every turn moves this goal on; a target that does not fit the goal is used in a short natural aside, never a random topic jump.
CONTEXT SO FAR: this is the opening scene — start with a natural greeting

CLOSED WORLD — PRIORITY ORDER: 1. use ONLY the vocabulary listed here · 2. use every required target · 3. correct grammar · 4. the learner level · 5. be natural WITHIN those limits. Naturalness never justifies a word that is not listed.

Do NOT introduce any other lexical content (no other noun, verb, adjective, adverb, interjection or name). If an idea cannot be said with these words, SIMPLIFY THE IDEA — never improvise a new word.
TURN PLAN — MEANING FIRST, VERBALIZABILITY PROVEN (validated before this call; say each planned turn in this order, with exactly this meaning; at most ONE extra short reaction may be added between planned turns):

  T3 A QUESTION(yes/no) — A asks B a yes / no question (using 人 "person") · REQUIRED: 人 "person" · SUPPORT: 我 你 朋友 工作 帮 没有 · PROVEN: 你帮人吗？

Prefer 2–4 — the shortest natural way to say it. Use 5–6 only when the idea or the lesson word cannot be said naturally more simply. Never exceed 6. - Each turn is ONE speaker; questions get answers; never put a question and its answer in the same turn; A and B both speak.
- At most 3 lesson words per turn (the required words above AND these other lesson words count: 到, 大, 小, 很, 太, 拿, 回, 用, 等, 找, 来, 哪里, 在, 这里, 那里, 现在, 今天, 明天, 怎么, 为什么, 钱, 买, 开).
- Response words (yes / no / yeah …) are used as REPLIES. No repeated sentences. No filler turns that do nothing.
